note: Right of reply on the IR study (scfl-ir-study.html). John pastes what a manager sends; it is printed as given. Plain text only -- every character is escaped on the way out, so quotes, apostrophes and angle brackets are safe and no markup is interpreted. One object per reply, newest last. 'side' is 'expand', 'keep two' or '' for neither and only sets the badge colour. 'desk' is optional: paragraphs the desk adds underneath, which should answer a point rather than relitigate the paper. Rebuild with: python3 scripts/build_ir_study.py
